# postgresql_crdb_role_setting (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String) Role to apply the setting to. Use 'ALL' to apply to all roles.
- `setting_name` (String) Role setting name (e.g. 'statement_timeout').
- `setting_value` (String) Role setting value (e.g. '1m').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
